listitem.para: LOOP_1_HNSW_QUERY : Daily, fully autonomous — HNSW/BaoOptimizer retraining.
LOOP_2_WORKLOAD : Weekly, fully autonomous — workload-profile adaptation.

briefdescription.para: Run the automated data selection pipeline for a specific adapter.

detaileddescription.para: Loads (or reloads) configuration from lora_trainer_config_path if set, executes all five data-selection stages on the provided candidate samples, applies adaptive self-improvement rules to the config for the next run, and returns the selection result including the JSONL audit entry.
This is called automatically during runLoRARetraining() and can also be invoked directly for manual testing or scheduled jobs.

briefdescription.para: Get the current optimized retrieval parameters.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the retrieval parameters most recently updated by the adaptive optimization loop. Callers should apply these parameters when issuing retrieval requests so that the system benefits from online learning.

The parameters are updated every time triggerLearningIteration() runs and sufficient feedback (both user signals and evaluation confidence scores) has been collected. Until the first optimization cycle the method returns the default values from RetrievalParams.

briefdescription.para: Return the currently active loop phase (IDLE when no loop runs).
Explicitly trigger a named learning loop.

detaileddescription.para: Runs the loop's phase-specific adaptation routine and guardrail check. The registered completion handler (if any) is invoked synchronously before returning.

parameterdescription.para: Loop to trigger. Passing IDLE is a no-op.

briefdescription.para: Trigger Loop 1 — per-query BaoOptimizer feedback (target: ≤ 10 ms).

detaileddescription.para: Stores outcome for the JSON context serialiser, then delegates to triggerLoop(LOOP_1_HNSW_QUERY). Returns a cooldown-blocked result if called within the configured cooldown window.

parameterdescription.para: Typed query execution result from the query executor.

simplesect.para: LoopResult; success == false and adapter_version == "cooldown" when the call is rejected due to the per-resource cooldown guard.

briefdescription.para: Trigger Loop 2 — WorkloadAdaptiveOptimizer + HNSW (60 s interval).

detaileddescription.para: Delegates to triggerLoop(LOOP_2_WORKLOAD) after the cooldown guard passes.
Advisory-only; always passes the guardrail. Delegates to triggerLoop(LOOP_3_SCHEMA_INDEX) after the cooldown guard passes.
Delegates to triggerLoop(LOOP_4_RLAIF). On success + guardrail pass, FEDERATED_ROUND_START is fired automatically.
Set Optimization Cooldown.
Any triggerLoopN*() call issued within cooldown of the previous invocation for the same loop is rejected (returns cooldown-blocked result). Default: 10 s.

cooldown
Minimum interval between successive triggers of the same loop.
cooldown
Input parameter.
Calls: lock().

briefdescription.para: Serialise the latest Loop 1–3 outcome signals to a JSON context block.

detaileddescription.para: Returns a compact JSON string of at most 2 000 tokens (approx. 8 000 chars) suitable for injection into an LLM prompt or decision-record context. Fields include: loop_id, phase, latency_ms (Loop 1), metric_delta, adapter_version, timestamp_iso.

simplesect.para: JSON string; empty object {} when no loops have been triggered yet.

briefdescription.para: Register a completion handler for a specific loop phase.

detaileddescription.para: The handler is called (synchronously) at the end of every triggerLoop() invocation for the specified phase. Only one handler per phase is supported; a second call overwrites the previous one.

briefdescription.para: Inject a BaoOptimizer miss-rate provider for Loop 1 guardrail checks.

detaileddescription.para: The callback should return the current HNSW query miss-rate in [0.0, 1.0]. Loop 1's guardrail passes when the returned value is below 0.05. Without a provider the guardrail falls back to the accuracy-proxy heuristic.
Roadmap ref: src/rag/ROADMAP.md §Phase 8 Loop 1

briefdescription.para: Inject a WorkloadAdaptiveOptimizer drift provider for Loop 2.

detaileddescription.para: The callback should return the current workload profile drift in [0.0, 1.0]. Loop 2's guardrail passes when the returned value is below 0.1. Without a provider the guardrail falls back to the accuracy-proxy heuristic.
Roadmap ref: src/rag/ROADMAP.md §Phase 8 Loop 2

briefdescription.para: Inject a FeedbackCollector new-entry-count provider for Loop 4.

detaileddescription.para: The callback should return the number of new feedback entries since the last Loop-4 run. Loop 4 only commits a new adapter when the count reaches ≥ 100. Without a provider the guardrail falls back to the accuracy-proxy heuristic.
Roadmap ref: src/rag/ROADMAP.md §Phase 8 Loop 4

Main class that coordinates automatic learning across all RAG components. Implements trigger-based retraining, prompt optimization, retrieval tuning, and A/B testing with statistical validation.
